stock.question: Does a single public-definition/owned-partner acquisition adapter remedy the demonstrated zero-value interface limitation and improve held-out fixed-family pair support at matched simulation cost without reducing win quality?
stock.previous_terminal: The fixed pair-v1 root73409000 V5 support failure stays closed. New controller capability is the changed prerequisite; this is not another attempt to sample a favourable stock family.

controller_delta.scope: Acquisition ranking and acceptance in card reward/event choices and shops only. Combat scoring, removal/upgrade/route heuristics, native rules, candidate content and RandomBuild are unchanged.
controller_delta.source_value: Add existing policy.status.venomousAsh exactly once to an offered Bloodfire producer, only on Ash and when actual source/consumer public effects exist.
controller_delta.partner_value: Add 2 * existing policy.card.aspectBonus once if an already owned counterpart actually has the matching public effect. 2 is the recorded historical selected acquisitionPriority, not fit to new outcomes.
controller_delta.provenance: pair-v1/postrun-1/HISTORICAL-CONTROLLER-SOURCE.json and minimum-v1 selected history. The historical full pilot/scalar substrate is not installed.
controller_delta.limits: This adapter does not model affordability ahead of the existing checks, inspect hidden draw/RNG or optimise arbitrary new effects. It does not claim that nominal bonus is proportional to actual value. Hand valuation unchanged.

stock.cohort_rule: Same128 unfiltered shipping parameter vectors and same4seeds for stock and aware. No changed sampler distribution, bans, card injections, post-outcome parameter changes or hidden state. Canonical policy vectors paired and checked directly.
stock.qualification: Full catalogue base/up query matrix on four fixed sampled vectors plus default, both aspects/random modes and four owned-deck configurations; absent public law and no-query-side-effect checks. Four full RandomBuild stock/aware endpoint pairs, eight stock/observer full endpoint pairs. 24 whole-run outcomes are qualification only and excluded from comparisons. No repeated old clone fixture stage.
stock.stopping: Qualify first. Complete both512-row V5 controllers. Continue once to the identical V0 rectangle only if all fixed controller value gates pass; else close at1024 comparison rows. Maximum2048 comparison outcomes, no extension. No new content candidate.
stock.comparison: Exact one-sided paired sign test over configuration activation discordance, fixed Bonferroni .025 per vow, activation difference>=.05, all unchanged inherited pair support gates, nonnegative win difference and95% paired configuration bootstrap lower bound>-.05. 5000 fixed resamples, seed421. These are a new controller experiment's criteria, not a weakening or replacement of P9 acceptance.

decisions.pass: This particular acquisition adapter has evidence of decision value in the frozen context; full package/descriptor/independent confirmation and retention still not established.
decisions.fail: Do not admit the adapter or run further conditional stages. Keep every old support and content negative closed. No second weight, partner formula or random root is authorised by this result.
decisions.inconclusive: Retain complete available bytes and concrete failure; correct delivery defects under unchanged inputs, never manufacture a scientific zero or rerun completed outcomes.

stock.preservation: Source/protocol committed before qualification; generated exact stock/aware runtimes committed before observations; complete matched chunks preserved remotely; complete sources, outcomes, clone traces and logs read back and all terminal readouts rebuilt offline.
stock.review: AUTHOR_SELF_REVIEW_NOT_INDEPENDENT. Source-shape, scope, duplicated/missing patch, random/other-aspect null, unsupported public-law absence, exact state/clone parity and paired identity failures are fail-closed. No independent package confirmation claim.
